 Read and discuss research papers with team members to develop familiarity with current approaches and techniques

 Communicate progress, ask questions, and incorporate feedback while working through assigned tasks 

 Share your work and key learnings through regular updates and a final presentation to the team

 Currently enrolled in an undergraduate (Bachelor's) or Master's degree program in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline

 Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts and an interest in exploring their practical applications 

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eagerness to learn new tools, techniques, and technologies 

 Knowledge of, or strong interest in, one or more of the following areas: real-time graphics, computer vision, machine learning, animation, large language models, speech recognition, speech synthesis, linguistics, performance capture, or 3D reconstruction 

 Exposure to academic research, relevant coursework, personal projects, or open-source contributions in machine learning, computer vision, computer graphics, or related technical areas 

 Familiarity with Unreal Engine or another game engine is a plus 

 Interest in games, digital humans, or real-time content creation

 At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.
 Your Impact 

 As an Axon CMM Metrology Programmer, you will perform dimensional and vision inspection and testing of incoming, in process, and finished product by using various measurement devices to ensure compliance with engineering specifications.

 What You’ll Do  

 Location: Onsite at Axon’s Pinnacle Manufacturing Location in Mesa, AZ

 Operate the Axon OPTICAL/TACTILE CMM (Zeiss OIS-322/Calypso) to provide measurement analysis for incoming parts, in process and finished goods.

 Program and Operate the Axon Keyence LM system to provide measurement analysis for incoming parts, in process and finished goods.

 Maintain PiWeb and QC gage DB, structure and dimensional plans for future analysis and studies. Perform GR&R according to scheduled plan. Conduct FAIR and PPAP dimensional reports to evaluate new or modified parts.

 Provide dimensional analysis for CAPA investigations to aid in root cause analysis.

 Read and interpret CAD models and prints.

 What You Bring 

 
 2-4 year degree in Technology/Engineering or equivalent experience.

 Basic knowledge of quality and lean manufacturing principles.

 Strong aptitude in process improvement and problem solving.

 Advanced Programming skill with Calypso: PCM, freeform, curve, simulation and planner modules.

 Minimum of 5 years OPTICAL and Tactile metrology experience.

 
 Minimum of 5 years working level experience measuring and programing CMM Zeiss Contura, CMM Zeiss OIS-322, Calypso Software and Keyence LM series.



 
 Benefits that Benefit You 

 
 Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

 Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

 What You'll Do 

 As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. Large context windows and retrieval systems are not enough. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory.

 In this role, you will 

 
 Design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products

 Define new ways to measure and evaluate memory performance 

 Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms 

 Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap 

 
 What we're looking for 

 
 PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience 

 Experience creating machine learning algorithms for vision and/or language problems and deploying them as production-level systems 

 Expert, hands-on knowledge of: 
 
 Foundational models and vision and/or language, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models 

 Memory, state, or long-horizon behaviour in foundation models: your experience may come from language agents and long-context methods, reinforcement learning under partial observability, world models, or sequence modelling 

 Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)
